candidate: Same base plus the src/memory.ts daily-memory atomic publication change in this PR.
runtime: Bun 1.4.4 on Windows and Ubuntu 24.04 WSL (ext4); one physical host.
setup: Install locked dependencies in each checkout. Use the candidate benchmark script for both source roots. Each invocation creates and cleans its own synthetic store.
order: For each round and size, baseline then candidate in rounds 1 and 3; candidate then baseline in round 2. Fresh process for every invocation.
samples: 12 sequential appends per invocation; discard first 2 as warmups. Pool remaining 10 across three rounds: 30 samples per mode/size/platform.
aggregation: Sort latencyMs ascending; median is average of positions 15 and 16; p95 is nearest rank ceil(0.95*30), position 29; max is position 30.
assertions: Original byte prefix unchanged and parsed row count equals seedRows + 12 in every invocation.
limitations: Synthetic warm-cache single-day-file workload, roughly 1 KiB seed rows.
Not independent machines or disks; no cold-cache, live-host, durability, or sustained-throughput claim.
Disk bytes written were not instrumented. Whole-file write amplification follows from implementation.
Small sample tails are noisy; raw measurements are retained.
Daily-memory publication only; other append-only logs remain outside the change and issue 198 stays open.
